account.intro.title: Keep your data with you
account.intro.body: Sync birth date, premium, and settings across phones.
account.deviceLimitBanner: This account is already used on {{max}} devices. Remove one to unlock premium here.
account.deviceLimitSheet: Premium needs a free device slot. Manage devices in Settings → Account.
account.desktop.title: Get Mac or Windows
account.desktop.a11y: Download UNTIL for Mac or Windows
account.desktop.slotNote: Menu bar or tray. Counts as one of your {{max}} devices.
account.signOutBody: Your data on this device stays put.
account.deleteBody.ios: This removes your UNTIL account and cloud data. Progress on this phone stays. Purchases stay with your Apple ID.
account.deleteBody.android: This removes your UNTIL account and cloud data. Progress on this phone stays. Purchases stay with your Google Play account.
account.deleteFailed.title: Account not deleted
account.passwordConfirm.title: Confirm password
account.removeDevice.title: Remove device
account.removeDevice.body: Remove {{device}}? It will need to sign in again to use premium.
account.devices.title: Devices
account.devices.rules: One Mac or Windows PC at a time. A device you haven't opened in {{days}} days stops using a slot.
account.device.replaceDesktop: UNTIL is already signed in on {{name}}. Signing in here turns that one off.
account.skipSheet.title: Without an account, data stays on this phone
account.skipSheet.body: If you change phones or reinstall, DOB and premium may not come with you.
account.resetNotice: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your spam folder too.
account.identity.title: When were you born?
account.identity.body: We use your birth date and expected lifespan to calculate life progress. Data stays on your device.
account.identity.lifespanNote: Lifespan estimates are based on global averages (about 73–85 years). Change this to match your goals or family history. It helps UNTIL show life progress.
account.error.signInAgain: Sign in again to delete your account.
account.error.enterPasswordToDelete: Enter your password to delete your account.
account.error.ageRequired: Confirm you are {{age}} or older to continue.
account.error.underAge: You need to be {{age}} or older to create an account. You can keep using UNTIL on this device without one.
account.error.passwordMin: Use a password with at least 6 characters.
account.error.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
account.error.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a bit and try again.
account.error.appleUnavailable: Sign in with Apple is not available on this device.
account.error.appleNotSetUp: Sign in with Apple is not set up yet.
account.error.signInApple: Could not sign in with Apple.
account.error.signInEmail: Could not sign in with email.
account.error.sendReset: Could not send the reset email.
account.error.verifyApple: Could not verify your Apple account.
account.error.verifyGoogle: Could not verify your Google account.
account.error.google.unavailable: Google sign-in is not available in this version yet. Use email to sign in.
account.error.google.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
account.error.google.playServices: Google Play services is missing or out of date. Update it and try again.
account.error.google.notFinished: Google sign-in did not finish. Try again, or use email.
